# docsfy

> Turn any Git repo into a polished, AI-readable documentation site you can browse, share, and download in minutes.

## Getting Started

- [Get Started with docsfy](quickstart.md): Set an admin key, start the server, sign in, and generate your first docs site from a Git repository in one short flow.

## User Guides

- [Track Generation Progress](track-generation-progress.md): Follow generation stages in real time through the dashboard, WebSocket updates, and CLI watch mode so you know what the system is doing.
- [Browse and Download Docs](browse-and-download-docs.md): Open the latest or variant-specific docs site, download a tarball or extracted copy, and find the AI-readable `llms.txt` outputs.

## Recipes

- [Run Common CLI Workflows](common-workflow-recipes.md): Copy commands for profile setup, watched generations, status by generation ID, flattened downloads, and day-to-day admin operations.

## Reference

- [HTTP API and WebSocket Reference](http-api-and-websocket-reference.md): Look up authentication rules, REST endpoints, WebSocket message types, and document-serving URLs for automation or integrations.
